# AWT Well Performance

> Regional commercial channel for candidate-led oil well production recovery across the Middle East, Africa, Europe and Canada.

## Canonical pages

- Executive overview: https://awtwellperformance.com/
- Technical Q&A: https://awtwellperformance.com/questions/

## What the site covers

AWT Well Performance helps operators screen mature, shut-in and underperforming oil wells for potentially recoverable production constraints associated with paraffin, wax, asphaltene, near-wellbore organic damage and artificial-lift friction.

The proposed decision sequence is: candidate screening, well-specific treatment design, controlled field evaluation, baseline comparison and a portfolio decision based on measured response.

The treatment concept has two stages. SolidsFree 432 STIM is presented as the restoration chemistry for established organic deposits. ALS Production Lubricant is presented as the sustaining stage for friction and future deposition control.

## Candidate fit

Useful signals include a credible pre-shut-in baseline, restart underperformance, dark paraffinic or asphaltic crude, organic-deposition history and changed lift-system load, torque, pressure or failure signals.

Mechanical failure, integrity risk, material incompatibility, dominant reservoir depletion, water-production problems or weak evidence of organic damage should stop or redirect the evaluation.

## Evidence and limits

The site distinguishes AWT product claims and cited field examples from forecasts. Analogue results do not predict a candidate well. Candidate-specific engineering, compatibility review, operating guardrails and operator approval remain necessary.
